title: Golden Axe: The Duel
native_title: ゴールデン・アックス ザ・デュエル
overview:
The battle of the mighty over the legendary axe begins!

Years after the war with Death Adder, the magical Golden Axe has resurfaced, its power grown stronger with time. Ten warriors, including Kain Blade, Milan Flare, Gillius Rockhead and Death Adder himself, now clash in one-on-one combat to claim it.

This is a 2D versus fighter with weapon slashes and kicks at three strengths, throws, blocking and special moves. Strike the little thieves that dash across the stage to make them drop potions and meat. Collect five potions to power up, then unleash a devastating super attack while the magic lasts.

- Arcade mode and a dedicated two-player versus mode
- Adjustable difficulty, game speed, round time, fighter strength and starting potions
- Virtua Stick compatible

伝説の斧をめぐる
強者たちの闘いが始まる!
